test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: The base of a right prism is an equilateral triangle with each side measuring 4 cm. If the lateral surface area is 120 cm², find the volume (in cm³) of the prism.
solution:
**Given:**

The base of a right prism is an equilateral triangle with each side measuring 4 cm. The lateral surface area is 120 cm².

**Formula used:**

Volume of prism = Base Area × Height

Base Area of equilateral triangle = dfrac{sqrt{3}}{4} times {side}²

Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter of base × Height

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of base = 3 × 4 = 12 cm

Lateral Surface Area = Perimeter of base × Height

120 = 12 × Height

⇒ Height = dfrac{120}{12}

⇒ Height = 10 cm

Base Area = dfrac{sqrt{3}}{4} times 4²

⇒ Base Area = dfrac{sqrt{3}}{4} times 16

⇒ Base Area = 4sqrt{3} cm²

Volume = Base Area × Height

⇒ Volume = 4sqrt{3} × 10

⇒ Volume = 40sqrt{3} cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 40sqrt{3}** cm3
